verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships built-in AI (Command, plus automatic categorization), so whether customer data trains AI models is a fair privacy question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, data-use controls, or a no-training policy. The citations only describe AI features grounded in account data, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
